description: Tutorial 11 Rhine 2021 event-specific ERA5-Land hourly runoff
access_notes: Researcher-acquired local data; originals, converted files and logs are Git-ignored. Confirm CDS access/licensing terms before redistribution.
distribution_scope: Tutorial 11 event-specific local input; not a repository sample or package dataset.
notes: Observed 20 raw and 20 converted daily NetCDF files, 24 hourly labels per day and a continuous 480-label sequence. Source variable ro [m]; converted runoff [mm per 1-hour record], float32, fill=1e20. Observed longitude centers 2.5..13.5E and latitude centers 53.5..44.5N at 0.1 degrees; inferred cell edges 2.45..13.55E, 44.45..53.55N. The existing ERA5land_global matrix in map/Rhine_15min targets the full 3600 x 1801 grid and is not interchangeable with this regional subset. Step 13 generated inpmat_ERA5land_Rhine2021Jul.bin and diminfo_ERA5land_Rhine2021Jul.txt for the 111 x 91 grid; see metadata/13_runoff_input_matrix.json. KG-0019 remains open: 00 UTC represents the preceding 24-hour accumulation and converter first-record/boundary treatment is not scientifically resolved.
